## Server logs icon set — `utils/emojis.py::LOG_EMOJIS`

The icon set of the advanced server logs (`docs/LOGS.md`). It is the
**only** source the logs configuration panel and the log messages draw
from — the module icon shown in the `/config` picker is the one
exception. Resolve one by name with `log_emoji("createchannel")`;
an unknown name returns an empty string rather than raising, so a typo
can never stop a log from being delivered.
